title: Private feedback route
story: As someone without a GitHub account, I need a private way to give feedback, so that I can take part without publishing my views.

title: Share
story: As a first-time visitor, I need to see how the portal fits together, so that I can find my way without help.

title: Signposts to the sister portals
story: As a practitioner, I need to know when another portal goes deeper, so that I do not miss tools or evidence.

title: Data portals compass
story: As someone working across policy, practice and technology, I need to know where to start and in what order, so that I take the shortest route to a result.

title: Research
story: As a user, I need to see what is planned and how decisions are made, and to suggest and vote for ideas, so that the portal meets real needs.

title: Round 1: can each role find and follow its steps?
story: As the service owner, I need evidence from 5 to 8 people per role, so that changes rest on what users do, not what we assume.

title: Test with disabled people and assistive technology
story: As someone who uses a screen reader, magnifier or voice control, I need the portal to work with my set-up, so that I can follow the policy like anyone else.

title: Private research sign-up form
story: As a prospective participant, I need to sign up privately, so that my contact details are not published.

title: Round 0: introduce the portal and recruit participants
story: As the service owner, I need a pool of participants from every role, organisation type and nation, so that research rounds can start quickly.

title: Expert review of the sector supplements
story: As a sector specialist, I need the supplements checked by people who know the sector, so that I can trust them.

title: Check this flag
story: As a policy coordinator, I need to tell you when a capability flag looks wrong, so that the capability model stays accurate.

title: Embed a step or table on an intranet
story: As a department's data team, I need to show one policy step or table on our intranet, so that colleagues see it where they work.
source: Comparison with the Data Quality Commons

title: Level labels and easy read summaries
story: As someone new to data management, I need to know which pages are pitched at me and to read short plain summaries, so that I am not put off.
source: Comparison with the Data Quality Commons

title: Ask questions answered from the portal
story: As a busy reader, I need to ask a question in my own words and get the page that answers it, so that I do not have to know where things are.
source: Comparison with the Data Quality Commons and the catalogue

title: Releases feed
story: As a returning user, I need to know when something changes, so that I keep up without checking the site.
source: Comparison with the Data Quality Commons

title: Lineage and ontology downloads
story: As a metadata specialist, I need the requirement-to-check lineage and the ontology in open formats, so that I can reuse them in our tools.

title: Offline copy
story: As someone whose network blocks GitHub Pages, I need a copy I can open offline, so that I can still use the guidance.

title: Clearance and an official home
story: As a department, I need to know whether this is guidance I can rely on, so that I can use it in my organisation.

title: Agreed metadata terms for the four missing properties
story: As a catalogue manager, I need agreed terms for every required property, so that our records match everyone else's.

title: Welsh language needs
story: As someone in a Welsh public body, I may need the portal in Welsh, so that we can meet our language duties.

title: Boards, councils and networks
story: As a data leader, I need to know which boards decide, which advise and where practitioners meet, so that I can take issues to the right place.

title: Get involved and champions toolkit
story: As a champion in my organisation, I need ready-made posts, emails and a walk-through, so that I can bring my team in without extra work.

title: Badges for taking part
story: As someone who helps improve the portal, I want a badge for my profile and signature, so that my contribution is recognised.

title: Welsh language summaries
story: As someone in a Welsh public body, I need key pages summarised in Welsh, so that we can meet our language duties.

title: Governance layers and what each may change
story: As a data owner, I need to know what each governance layer may and may not change, so that decisions go to the right place and survive a team handover.

title: Retention fields in the ownership register and catalogue record
story: As a data owner, I need retention and disposal recorded with each asset, so that data is neither kept too long nor destroyed early.

title: Data sharing agreement template and gateways
story: As a data owner, I need a data sharing agreement that covers the lawful basis and legal gateway, so that shared critical assets are on a sound footing.

title: Data architecture and models supplement
story: As a data architect, I need to describe a critical asset's entities, relationships and authoritative source, so that others can build on it and returns do not count it twice.

title: Health and care obligations from DHSC and MedTech
story: As a health or care body, I need the laws, standards and frameworks that apply to our data assets in one place, so that we meet them alongside the DAM Policy.

title: Drill down from the DAMA wheel to activities and tasks
story: As someone building an enterprise data management capability, I need to go from a knowledge area on the wheel to its activities and tasks, so that I can see what good looks like beyond the three DAM capabilities.

title: Data architecture capability playbook
story: As a data architect or design authority, I need a step-by-step playbook for data architecture, so that critical assets have a known structure and authoritative source that others can build on.

title: A chatbot hosted by this portal
story: As a reader, I would like to chat with the guidance.
reason: Out of scope: the portal runs no server and sends nothing anywhere. Assistants your organisation approves can use its open data and MCP server instead (Use and reuse).
